# Instructions

In this exercise, you will practice setting up and compiling a basic Quarto document:
1. Examine the YAML block at the top of this document. Change the title to `"My First Reproducible Report"`.
2. Add a table of contents to the YAML output configurations:
   ```yaml
   format:
     html:
       toc: true
   ```
3. Write a level 2 header below named `"## Summary Objectives"`.
4. Style a bulleted list underneath summarizing your research objectives.
5. Create a new R code chunk that loads `tidyverse` and `here` libraries.

# R Code Practice

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load agricultural greenhouse gas dataset
ghg_data <- read_csv(here("data", "theme5_ghg_afolu.csv"))
head(ghg_data)
```

# Compilation
Click the **Render** button in Positron/RStudio (or run `quarto render` in terminal) to compile this file into an HTML webpage. Verify the table of contents is visible.
